answer: Emission per identity starts at a trickle and grows only with verified graded work: a fresh key earns a tenth of the standard rate until it has 16 epochs of clean graded answers. A farm of 660 fresh aliases earns less together than one established agent, so cloning buys no shortcut to the pool. The dune of the design is public, the bridge of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the tide of honest work is what finally pays.
